targets.expr:
label_replace(
  (
    sum(rate(ydb_resources_cpu_used_core_percents{stroppy_run_id="$run_id",stroppy_machine_id=~"$Instance"}[$Interval])) 
    / 
    sum(ydb_resources_cpu_total_core_percents{stroppy_run_id="$run_id",stroppy_machine_id=~"$Instance"})
  )
  and on()
  (
    sum(ydb_resources_cpu_limit_core_percents{stroppy_run_id="$run_id",stroppy_machine_id=~"$Instance"}) 
    > 
    sum(ydb_resources_cpu_total_core_percents{stroppy_run_id="$run_id",stroppy_machine_id=~"$Instance"})
  ),
  "pool", "CPU utilization", "", ""
)

or

(
  (sum by (pool) (rate(ydb_resources_cpu_used_core_percents{stroppy_run_id="$run_id", container="ydb-dynamic"}[$Interval]))) 
  / 
  (sum by (pool) (ydb_resources_cpu_limit_core_percents{stroppy_run_id="$run_id", container="ydb-dynamic"}))
)
* on() group_left()
(
  sum(ydb_resources_cpu_limit_core_percents{stroppy_run_id="$run_id",stroppy_machine_id=~"$Instance"}) 
  <= bool 
  sum(ydb_resources_cpu_total_core_percents{stroppy_run_id="$run_id",stroppy_machine_id=~"$Instance"})
)
!= 0
